artifacts.summary: Split verdict on Muller sufficiency: Muller suffices for the Auxiliary-Atoms rule (acceptance-condition-free antecedent, determinism is the sole demand) but NOT for the ban/lull mechanism (Reynolds' banned list is indexed by accepting pairs). (O1) preserved with sharpened ground; Muller.toRabin_exists is the single highest-value gap. (O2) discharged for free by Muller.exists_iSup under a union-first composition order. Two-state countermodel proves pair-enumeration repair is unsound, not merely incomplete.

next_steps: Run /orchestrate 903 to create implementation plan. Report recommends three record amendments (902's (O1) and Risks bullet 1; 902's (O2) and recommendation 6; 879's row 16 and verdict paragraph 3) and one narrowed CSLib-side item (a NAMED Muller.toRabinLAR rather than the existential proof_wanted). No Lean work, no require, no completeness claim.

metadata.verdict: split: Muller suffices for the AA rule; Muller does NOT suffice for the ban/lull mechanism; (O1) preserved, (O2) discharged
